Downtown Topeka.name: Downtown Topeka
Downtown Topeka.description: Downtown Topeka civic core with the Capitol, the Evergy Plaza, and the Kansas Avenue commercial corridor's steady mixed-use and office permitting.

NOTO Arts District.name: NOTO Arts District
NOTO Arts District.description: North Topeka Arts District with gallery and studio conversions, adaptive-reuse, and the Redbud and First Friday pedestrian traffic.

Central Topeka.name: Central Topeka
Central Topeka.description: Central Topeka corridor along 10th and 6th Avenues with older commercial stock, the Washburn University adjacency, and steady commercial renovation.

Chesney Park.name: Chesney Park
Chesney Park.description: Established central residential neighborhood with pre-war housing stock, the Gage Park adjacency, and steady renovation permits.

East Topeka.name: East Topeka
East Topeka.description: East Topeka corridor along Kansas Avenue and 6th Street with older commercial and industrial permitting and the Forbes Field adjacency.

Highland Park.name: Highland Park
Highland Park.description: Highland Park neighborhood southeast of downtown with post-war single-family and small commercial permitting.

West Topeka.name: West Topeka
West Topeka.description: West Topeka growth corridor along Wanamaker Road with big-box retail, the West Ridge Mall, and strong commercial tenant-improvement volume.

Huntoon / West 6th.name: Huntoon / West 6th
Huntoon / West 6th.description: Huntoon and West 6th corridor with automotive and service commercial, new subdivisions, and residential infill.

South Topeka.name: South Topeka
South Topeka.description: South Topeka residential belt with subdivision expansion, the Topeka High adjacency, and steady single-family permitting.
